title: polyEval at length 0 is the zero polynomial's value
statement: For any coefficient function c and point x: polyEval c 0 x = 0 -- the base case of Horner evaluation, proved by Eq.refl and registered as a first-class named equation (Definitions are excluded from the theorem inventory, so this defining equation is stated and checked explicitly rather than left implicit).

formal.statement: theorem Complex.polyEval_zero : ((x0 : ((x0 : AxNat) -> Complex)) -> ((x1 : Complex) -> Eq.{1} Complex (Complex.polyEval x0 AxNat.zero x1) Complex.zero))

evidence.supports: Complex.polyEval_zero is admitted by the trusted kernel gate with the type recorded in formal.statement.
